subject: Mercury Health — PO & invoice cadence / net terms request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@mercuryhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@mercuryhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:45:12 -0800
Subject: Mercury Health — PO & invoice cadence / net terms request

Hi Karthik / Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers and the KV-cache workflow. Procurement asked me to confirm a few details before we proceed to redlines:

1) PO requirements: our AP team requires PO line-item matchback (PO number on invoice and line references). Can you accept a blanket PO for the year with multiple release schedules? If so we prefer consolidated monthly invoices against that blanket PO.

2) Net terms: standard is net60 for our vertical, but we can consider net30 if there is a price concession. What is Redwood's standard net-term ladder and where are discount breakpoints?

3) Invoice cadence: consolidated monthly vs weekly statements — which options do you support, and any constraints on invoice size/line limits?

I've attached our PO template and the initial commercial quote you provided. Please confirm the vendor/remit details we should include in our PO so ERP matches cleanly.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Procurement Lead
Mercury Health
Attachments: PO_Template_Mercury.xlsx (xlsx), Quote_Redwood_110426.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:12:03 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mercury Health — PO & invoice cadence / net terms request

Hi Liam — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and then a few asks so we can finalize: 

- Blanket PO: yes, we can accept a blanket PO for the 12-month period. For consolidated monthly billing against a blanket PO we will require the PO to reference Redwood vendor number and indicate "blanket/statement" on the header so our ERP can aggregate.

- Net terms: our baseline public terms are net45. We can offer tiered concessions: net30 -> larger concession, net60 -> smaller concession. Vanessa and I have a recommended tradeoff matrix (see below). Any request for net90 would need an offset (prepay or price increase).

- Invoice cadence: we support consolidated monthly statements as long as the PO is a blanket PO. If you prefer release/delivery POs instead, we typically produce weekly invoices. There is no hard invoice-line cap, but certain ERPs require explicit line mapping; Ben can confirm specifics.

A couple of asks so we generate an addendum that maps to your template:
1) Confirm the exact remit address and AP email for invoice submission (our portal supports invoices@mercuryhealth.ap or EDI).
2) Confirm whether Mercury will provide a single blanket PO number per legal entity or multiple per BU.

Attaching our internal guidance doc that shows the required PO header fields we need for automated matching. If that aligns, Vanessa can share a formal counteroffer on pricing/discounts.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Merchant_PO_Guidance.pdf (pdf)

Karthik / Ben — quick internal note before we reply to Liam with numbers:

Proposal idea (we can present as a simple table in the addendum):
- Net30 -> 8% platform discount (annualized commit, 12-month minimum)
- Net45 -> 5% platform discount (standard offer)
- Net60 -> 2.5% platform discount (no prepayment)

If Mercury will sign a 12-month blanket PO and allow monthly consolidated invoices, we can give the net60 2.5% discount. If they insist on net90, need prepay or remove discount. Also suggest offering a 30-day trial credit for first month to lower friction.

I recommend we ask finance for the vendor number and exact remit wording before we send the formal addendum. Ben — can you confirm Redwood vendor number and whether EDI/portal submission works for monthly consolidated statements?

Thanks — I can draft the commercial addendum once we have vendor/remit lines.

- Vanessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 13:02:51 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mercury Health — PO & invoice cadence / net terms request

Hi all — looping in both internal thread and replying to Liam with the ERP/finance constraints we can accept: 

- Redwood vendor number: 84572 (please include on PO header).
- Remit: Redwood Payments, 420 Marin Ave, Suite 200, San Rafael, CA 94901; invoices@redwood-payments.com is our AP inbox.
- Invoice matching: we require PO number on invoice + line item references to match invoice to usage lines. For blanket PO monthly statements, include a per-invoice breakdown CSV (we can accept as attachment or SFTP drop).
- EDI: we support both EDI-850 and a CSV/portal feed. If Mercury wants our consolidated monthly statement against a blanket PO, we will accept that but require the blanket PO to be set at the legal-entity level. Multiple BU-level blanket POs are OK but will require separate invoice statements per BU.

On discounts: finance will approve the discount ranges Vanessa suggested subject to the annual commitment and the PO being in place before the first billing run. Net90 would require a prepayment schedule or a reduced discount (effectively moving to list price).

I'll prepare a short vendor addendum (PO header map + remit + vendor number) and attach it for signature. Vanessa — once you have the commercial table I can give final approval.

-Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — this is very helpful. Confirming next steps from Mercury side: 

- We will issue a single-entity blanket PO (one PO per legal entity) and opt for consolidated monthly invoices. That should satisfy our release cadence.
- Net60 is our preferred internal policy; given the smaller concession (+2.5%), procurement is comfortable with that if Redwood provides the vendor addendum and the monthly CSV breakdown to allow automated matchback.
- We'll route the PO to include vendor number 84572 and mark header as BLANKET_STATEMENT. AP will send the signed PO to invoices@redwood-payments.com.

Please send the vendor addendum + commercial addendum and the final quote for signature (DocuSign link preferred). Liam will attach the signed PO once we have the addendum.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Liam O'Connor
Senior Procurement Lead, Mercury Health
